summary: Lucas completed GitHub browser sign-in through the official same-Mac Tanduna helper. Its authenticated Codex session connected and returned the exact Renewal Engine project and repository through read-only MCP calls.

checks.outcome: No Tanduna MCP server initially configured; official public guide and login helper inspected.
Lucas reported sign-in completed; official helper confirmed configuration and launched Codex with short-lived token retained only in child environment.
Authenticated session runtime gpt-6-astra/high; tanduna.projects.search and tanduna.projects.get succeeded for Renewal Engine.
tanduna.tasks.list, tanduna.proposals.list, tanduna.task_plans.list_published and tanduna.task_plans.get_draft returned live project data.

limitations: Authorization is held by the official authenticated local Codex child session; the parent task has no copied token.
The short-lived session will need a fresh local login when it expires; direct MCP OAuth remains unavailable.
